description: This file defines data structures, classes, enums, and their relationships for representing channel scan capabilities within a wireless framework. It includes class definitions for tlvChannelScanCapabilities, cRadiosWithScanCapabilities, cOperatingClasses, and sCapabilities, along with associated enum eScanImpact, and various property descriptions, comments, and references.

classes.name: tlvChannelScanCapabilities
classes.description: Class representing channel scan capabilities, including a list of radios and related properties.

classes.name: cRadiosWithScanCapabilities
classes.description: Class representing radio details along with scan capabilities and operating classes.

classes.name: sCapabilities
classes.description: Struct representing various capabilities of a radio, including boot-only operation and scan impact.

classes.name: cOperatingClasses
classes.description: Class representing an operating class with associated channel lists.
